SummaryOfPosition.Summary: The Respondent contends that the boundary is as shown on his title plan, alternatively that he has acquired title to the disputed strip by adverse possession.

FactsReliedOn.item: The Respondent has maintained the disputed strip as part of his garden since purchasing in 1998.
The fence was present when the Respondent purchased and he has maintained it continuously since.
The Respondent and his predecessors have possessed the disputed strip for more than 12 years before 2003.
The Appellants and their predecessors never objected to the fence position.
The Respondent's use has been open, continuous and adverse.

Contentions.item: The Respondent acquired title by adverse possession before 13 October 2003.
Alternatively, the boundary has been established by long acquiescence.
The Appellants' predecessors accepted the fence line as the boundary.
It would be inequitable to require removal of the fence after such long possession.
